description: This file defines an interface for handling card flip events, specifically for indicating the start and end of a flip animation within an Android app.

classes.name: CardFlipListener
classes.description: An interface used to handle callbacks related to card flip animations, allowing other components to respond when a flip starts or ends.

methods.name: onCardFlipEnd
methods.description: Callback invoked when a card flip animation completes.

methods.name: onCardFlipStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when a card flip animation begins.
